certifyme.claim: Institutional issuers: universities, professional bodies, enterprises and training organizations.
Connected institutional credential infrastructure linking awards, reviewed skills, learner records and Job Engine workforce intelligence.
Digital credential issuance and verification with open-standard achievement and record context.
Digital badges represent institution-authorized achievements; confirm the implemented format.
Public registry lists active Open Badges 3.0 Issuer certification for the specified CertifyMe product.
OB3/CLR achievement profiles use the VC model. No general W3C certification or universal v2.0/proof-suite support is inferred.
Public registry lists active CLR 2.0 Issuer and Displayer roles for the specified product.
Institution-led taxonomy mapping keeps reviewed outcomes and evidence authoritative; no native reference-framework connector is inferred.
Connected achievements with issuer/evidence provenance; a learner-facing Skill Passport is not a new standards certification.
Credential-associated skills are related to occupational/hiring context. Source permissions, coverage and contractual availability require review.
Check record proof, issuer and relevant lifecycle resources; this is not independent identity verification.
Credential/programme analytics are documented; agree metrics and export requirements rather than treating engagement as a career outcome.
API documentation and integration workflows are published; confirm the current field contract, authentication, entitlements and retry behavior.
An integrations directory is published; validate each required connector and scope before procurement.
Public security page states scoped assurance information. Review examination period, management-system scope, customer controls and current documents.
Hosting is available globally. Confirm storage locations, backups, support access and transfers against the data-residency terms in your contract.
Assess the current public plan/enterprise quote, volume, inclusions and deployment requirements; no universal competitor price advantage is claimed.
Confirm actual minimum term, renewal, SLA, retention and verification continuity in the agreement.
University buyer journey connects Registrar, academic, IT/security and careers responsibilities.
SSO and MFA are standard for enterprise customers. Confirm supported protocols, deployment details and contractual controls for your institution.
Programme owners retain assessment, certification criteria, renewal and record authority.
Institutional curriculum relevance and career context; no employment or salary guarantee.
